purpose: Teach: 呪術/プラチナ/奏法/水力/日没/縫製/体外/亜鉛

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、平安朝の呪術文化の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on curse culture in the Heian period, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Slight upward lift on the topic, inviting confirmation. Steady pace. The tone of a teacher checking notes she already knows the answer to.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、プラチナ触媒の化学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on platinum catalyst chemistry.
lines.style: Quiet, straightforward. No defensiveness, just clear correction. Slight pause before speaking, as if he's accepted the pattern of these mismatches and is simply stating fact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ピアノの古典派奏法を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on classical piano technique, didn't you?
lines.style: Same warm opening as before, but with a gentle curiosity underneath—noticing the pattern herself now. Slight pause mid-sentence, as if she's listening to what she's saying.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、水力発電所の歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the history of hydroelectric power stations.
lines.style: Same quiet correction, but with the faintest trace of resignation. He knows where this is going. Still polite, still clear, but the patience is beginning to show wear.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 日没時間と健康行動の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote your paper on the relationship between sunset times and health behaviors, didn't you?
lines.style: Faster now, more engaged. She's dropped his name—a sign she's genuinely focused. Slight edge of realization creeping in. The cadence of someone who's almost figured something out.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、衣料縫製業の労働史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the labor history of textile manufacturing.
lines.style: Quieter still. The corrections are coming faster now and he's keeping up with them, each one delivered with the same gentle precision. A rhythm of acceptance.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、体外受精技術の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on in vitro fertilization technology, didn't you?
lines.style: Slower now, more deliberate. The realization has landed fully. Her voice carries the weight of understanding what's happening. A gentle probe—checking if he'll finally say something.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、亜鉛欠乏症の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on zinc deficiency disorders.
lines.style: Even quieter than before, almost a whisper. This final correction lands with the exhaustion of someone who has been corrected repeatedly and has accepted it as inevitable. The last one. A small, weary close.
